h1: Pet Diagnostics — Health Landing Page Design
tagline: Landing page reference for a health or wellbeing product, captured at 2336x1080 with the layout, timings and palette specified in the brief.
summary: Landing page reference for a health or wellbeing product — a dark stage, one self-contained HTML file, Inter and fluid type.
about: Pet Diagnostics solves the landing page problem for a health or wellbeing product with a single captured brief. The colour scheme is #101010 underneath and cream #EEF0D0 for the type, and the page is set in Inter. Delivery is one self-contained HTML file, captured at 2336x1080 so the frame is fixed before any code is written. Motion is limited to a looping video bed. If you are briefing a health landing page, start from this composition and replace the subject.

layout.title: Links before the action
layout.body: The wordmark holds the left edge and the links run to the right of it, all of it set in Inter so the bar belongs to the page below rather than to a separate system. Labels are short enough to fit one line at 820px, and the active item is marked with weight rather than with a pill.

layout.title: A full-bleed clip behind the type
layout.body: The brief specifies the video at 2336x1080 with a loop of 7.1s, and every text element is placed against that frame. The loop is short enough (7.1s) that the eye reads it as texture rather than as a timeline.

layout.title: The scale is clamped, not stepped
layout.body: The top of the scale is fluid (a clamp between 12px and 16px) and the rest is fixed, so the frame stays composed as the viewport narrows. Controls stay large enough to tap and the copy keeps its reading order at every width.

layout.title: One row, no drawers
layout.body: Below 820px the links collapse instead of wrapping onto a second line.

motion.title: A loop, not a timeline
motion.body: Ambient movement comes from the 7.1s 2336x1080 loop rather than from scroll effects, which keeps the page calm and the type readable. A poster frame stands in when autoplay is blocked, so the motion is additive rather than required.

motion.title: Feedback on the controls
motion.body: The interactive layer is small and predictable: hover states on the buttons and links rather than on every card. Everything else stays still, which keeps the emphasis on the composition. The states are named in the brief, so the page does not depend on a hover-effect library.

style.glass: Panels are translucent over #101010, and the type on top stays at full contrast so the effect never costs readability.
notes: Panel corners reuse the radius list in the brief (999px), so the grid needs no separate treatment.
The display line is Inter at the top of a 12–16px scale, with the interface text on the same face.
The clip is one asset at 2336x1080 and a 7.1s loop, so the composition has a single media dependency.

editorial.title: What to change first in Pet Diagnostics
editorial.body: Where a theme hands you components, this brief hands you a composition: type from 12px to 16px, 92vh sections, 999px corners and 18px spacing steps and a media frame, with the subject left to you. The composition is the reusable part, and it survives a different brand.

editorial.title: What this landing page gets right
editorial.body: Compared with a template hero, the difference is what is missing. There is no card grid, no carousel and no second call to action: only navigation, the headline, the announcement badge, the stats row and the card grid, sized against type from 12px to 16px and 92vh sections. It gives a health reader the shortest honest route to the offer.

editorial.title: The timing behind the landing page
editorial.body: Every transition here has a number attached. That is why hover and press states and a 7.1s media loop can be ported value by value instead of re-tuned by feel. Nothing animates for its own sake in this landing page.

faq.question: Why does the entry name one self-contained HTML file at all?
faq.answer: Pet Diagnostics was built in one self-contained HTML file, and the entry says so for provenance. The brief describes positions, sizes and timings, so it rebuilds in any framework that can set type and place elements.

faq.question: What can I do with the Pet Diagnostics brief once I have it?
faq.answer: Everything quoted on the page comes from the captured 18,711-character brief rather than from a description written afterwards. That is why the numbers and the prose agree.
